title: Sudan's growing food crisis
summary: Conflict and economic collapse have pushed millions of people in Sudan into acute food insecurity, with famine conditions confirmed in parts of the country.

title: Drought threatens communities in Kenya
summary: Consecutive failed rainy seasons have left pastoral communities in northern Kenya without reliable access to water and grazing land.

title: Conflict deepens Yemen's humanitarian emergency
summary: Ongoing conflict continues to disrupt access to food, clean water and medical care for millions of people across Yemen.

title: Cholera outbreak strains Haiti's health system
summary: A resurgence of cholera cases is overwhelming already fragile health infrastructure amid ongoing insecurity in Haiti.
